svg.text: Discrete separated PFP sources and a uniform mean-mode population
N = 3 or 5; centers s_i on r_c = 200 μm circle
Same total E₀ = 55 nJ, equal activation, no imposed array steering
i, j: source indices; Q_i: volume flux; s_i: center; d_ij = |s_i − s_j|; Q_tot = ΣQ_i; p_i^inc: incident wave pressure.
E₀ = ΣE_i is fixed while N changes; ρ, c: water properties; τ_i = a_i√(ρ/p∞); Ω_pop: population volume.
n = N/|Ω_pop|: number density; f_dist = −nQ: source for φ wave PDE; ϕ_v = n(4πR³/3): bubble void fraction.
⟨p_ac⟩_pop: common source feedback; local pressure variance is not represented by separate bubble states.
Observed p_f is area/volume and time filtered at the fixed receiver. Interference, phase evolution and shared wave work matter.
